name: Sin senos sí hay paraíso
description: A young woman born in a mafia-controlled town seeks revenge on those who wrongfully harmed and imprisoned her family.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Hilda Santana visits her child’s grave and receives some terrible news. When she gives birth to a girl, she calls her by her eldest daughter’s name.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Catalina breaks her family’s rules and crosses the line her mother spoke about so often. Martina has to convince Catalina to operate on her breasts.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Daniela and Diabla get their way and Catalina’s family and boyfriend are arrested. An emissary steals an important document from the Santanas.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Catalina’s punishments at the correctional facility push her to the limit. Daniela asks to have Nachito freed and they hire him as her bodyguard.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Catalina escapes from the hospital but her freedom is short-lived. Diabla knows that the marriage certificate gives Hilda right to Marcial's fortune.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Tired of being abused in the jail, Catalina is pushed to her limit and tries to defend herself. Dr. Rico loses his job for helping her.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Nachito signs the documents without knowing what they mean. Albeiro admits his guilt. A journalist investigates the case and accuses the mayor’s wife.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Diabla gets the Marín Santanas and Nachito out of jail before the journalists and authorities show up. Then, she hires a hacker.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: The guards make Catalina sign a document saying she wasn’t physically or psychologically abused. She vows she’ll get revenge on Diabla and her goons.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: La Diabla and Colonel Herrera discuss the Cerón case. Catalina’s thirst for vengeance leads her to a bad decision.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Two options to make dirty money tempt Catalina. The journalist visits Catalina’s parents and they leave him on the street. His life is at risk.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Catalina confronts her parents, blames them for locking her up all those years and demands that they tell her the truth about her past.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Nachito begs Daniela not to kill him. Octavio must get the Santanas to sell him the house. They accuse the journalist of drug trafficking.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Nachito is threatened by Daniela and has to accept Diabla’s requests in order to protect his mother. Martina sells Catalina’s “services” to Octavio.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Nachito gives in to Diabla’s request in order to protect his mother. Jotica gets the Santanas’s house back. Hilda holds the key to her fortune.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Nachito will have to pass Diabla’s test to free himself from her punishments. Herrera rebels, and Diabla blackmails him.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Daniela’s obsession with Nachito makes her disobey her mother. Gato Gordo and Octavio compete for Catalina. Herrera interviews the mayor.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Catalina accepts Gato Gordo’s gift but lies to her parents. The mayor and his wife argue about Catalina’s threat. Diabla makes her power known.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Albeiro goes to the meeting thinking that it’s only with Jotica but there’s a surprise in store for him. Martina offers Catalina a juicy advance.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Albeiro goes to the meeting and finds Jotica with a catheter. Gato Gordo asks Diabla to use her route.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Diabla forces Nachito to kill Colonel Herrera. Marcial promises the Santanas that once he is free he’ll give them Catalina the elder’s money.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Pipe confesses that he was recruited like Nachito and promises to help him. Killing the colonel is Nachito’s acid test to save his mother.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Octavio sees specters and thinks that it’s Catalina the elder. Daniel, Cata and Lucía follow Daniela to see if she’ll lead them to Diabla and Nachito.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Catalina goes into Diabla’s ranch to find Nachito. Daniela asks her mother to free the love of her life. Aníbal finds out what his wife did.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Diabla must accept her daugther’s relationship with Nachito. Marcial wants to free Aurelio Jaramillo, imprisoned in the USA, to kill his worst enemy.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Catalina finds out the hard truth about her sister and father. Pelambre asks for forgiveness. Catalina will surrender to Gato Gordo on two conditions.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Catalina looks for Pelambre where her sister died. He still wants to kill Diabla but doesn’t have the power or men to do it.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Daniela undresses in front of Nachito. Diabla orders Franklin to torture Lucía. Martina takes a picture of Daniela with Nachito.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Martina gives Catalina one more day to finish Gato Gordo off. Daniel is worried that Lucía’s life is at stake. Marcial knows where she is.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: The time has come for Pelambre to avenge Catalina the elder. The mayor is furious with his wife. Diabla keeps Daniela locked up.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Pelambre is carried out of Diabla’s house on a stretcher. Daniela provokes Catalina and gives Nachito a new order.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Diabla thinks that Catalina the elder is still alive. The mayor says that the assassin survived six shots. Martina goes after Catalina.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Gato Gordo kidnaps Catalina to operate on her breasts. Marcial wants to off Diabla. Daniela visits her mother in the hospital and gets some advice.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Daniela keeps trying to make Nachito fall in love with her. Later, she goes crazy trying to find out where she is and who kidnapped her.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Diabla and Albeiro threaten each other about their daughters. Daniela and Marcial talk about the past. Catalina is shocked by her transformation.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Catalina is thirsting for revenge. Diabla tortures and pressures Pipe for letting them kidnap her daughter. Daniela finds out about her mother’s past.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Diabla gets furious and argues with Aníbal about the lawsuit. The mayor has good lawyers but she has a better idea. Daniela grows closer to Marcial.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Marcial celebrates Titi’s arrival and thanks him for his help. As a father, he spoils his daughter and hugs her for the first time.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Catalina plans to take revenge on Diabla. Albeiro and his wife would give up their inheritance to get their daughter back.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Diabla is obsessed with the idea that Catalina the elder is alive. In order to rescue her daughter, she agrees on a 48-hour period with the police.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Catalina takes advantage of the opportunity to ask her doctor to stop calling her parents. Marcial visits Pelambre and they have an emotional goodbye.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Catalina’s parents are desperate and Diabla threatens them. They pressure Catalina’s doctor to release her. Gato Gordo is losing his patience.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Diabla and Octavio Rangel make a pact. She knows that the TEA agents are tailing her and panics. Daniel looks for Aurora, the journalist’s mother.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: The plastic surgeon has an idea for Catalina. Jota follows Vanessa and discovers her stark reality. Diabla presses Nachito to find out about Daniela.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: Jota and Vanessa want to escape the brothel but they can’t do it alone. With Albeiro’s help they will try to outsmart a human trafficking network.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: Gato Gordo plans a welcome party for the new Catalina even though she’s hurt by what they did to her. Catalina and the doctor have a heart to heart.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: Before sleeping with him, Catalina asks Gato Gordo for twice the amount they had agreed upon. Meanwhile, Diabla's men prepare to attack the mansion.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: The attack on Gato Gordo’s mansion works in Catalina’s favor. A masked Nachito sees the love of his life and thinks that she slept with Gato Gordo.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: Pipe can’t bear to see Nachito so excited about saving his mother and tells him the truth. Catalina tells her friends and Jota what happened.

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: Catalina and her friends follow the clues from Octavio’s letter. Daniela asks to say goodbye to her mother and warns her that they want to kill her.

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: Daniela makes a terrible decision to distract her father. Catalina and her friends follow the clues her older sister left about the money.

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: Marcial and his armed men attack Diabla’s mansion. Catalina and her friends don’t find the loot her sister left. Octavio sets up a date with Diabla.

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: Diabla concocts her next plan. Daniela escapes from the hospital and meets up with her mother. Titi takes the blame for not killing Diabla.

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: Catalina finds her sister’s money and puts her revenge scheme into action. Marcial and his men escape from the TEA and plan the attack on Diabla.

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: Diabla’s plan is a success. Daniela visits her in the hospital and becomes her accomplice. Diabla manages to fool everyone except Marcial.

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: Anxious to take out her implants, Catalina visits the doctor but another operation is very dangerous. Diabla confronts Octavio.

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: After finding his daughter Albeiro rejects her and will hear no explanations. Nachito admits to Pipe that he still loves Catalina.

videos.title: Episode 58
videos.overview: Diabla puts Aníbal to the test. Catalina hides 40,000 dollars in the house and divides the rest among her friends.

videos.title: Episode 59
videos.overview: Right when Nachito is ready to get Catalina back, Mugroso changes the plans. Catalina is confused, did she lose him? Did Daniela steal him away?

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: Someone unexpectedly interrupts the alleged funeral of Diabla. Daniela’s men obey and beat Albeiro. Catalina meets Titi at the cemetery.

videos.title: Episode 61
videos.overview: Diabla orders her men to kill everyone who knows she’s alive or who stops her from going home. The TEA grants Marcial and Titi supervised probation.

videos.title: Episode 62
videos.overview: A call reveals an evil plan. Catalina confirms that Daniela is Diabla’s daughter. Mugroso and his accomplices stage the crime scene.

videos.title: Episode 63
videos.overview: Catalina calls the neighborhood together to prevent another tragedy. Meanwhile, Albeiro recovers from his injuries. Daniela tries to seduce Nachito.

videos.title: Episode 64
videos.overview: Daniela leaves her bodyguards at home, which draws them closer to Diabla's fortune. One of Hilda’s ex-cellmates helps her flee and hide in a ranch.

videos.title: Episode 65
videos.overview: Nachito wins Daniela over and convinces her to help him--she’ll be the perfect alibi. The Maríns start a new life. Mugroso continues his plans.

videos.title: Episode 66
videos.overview: Diabla cries inconsolably over her mother’s death. Nachito wipes the fingerprints clean. Titi is on Catalina’s trail. Pipe has a proposal.

videos.title: Episode 67
videos.overview: Catalina’s house explodes. Catalina learns that Pipe left documents for Nachito. Albeiro goes crazy when he finds out his daughter has a cell phone.

videos.title: Episode 68
videos.overview: When Capitan Pérez is pressured by Diabla to find the Maríns’s remains, he creates false evidence. Pipe hides the stolen money.

videos.title: Episode 69
videos.overview: Valentina visits Adriana in the hospital. Albeiro and Hilda have no idea about the explosion. Diabla wants to go to her mother’s funeral.

videos.title: Episode 70
videos.overview: Catalina and Valentina want to avenge Adriana’s death. Diabla sees the Maríns alive. Nachito warns Daniela about her stepfather’s evil intentions.

videos.title: Episode 71
videos.overview: Catalina and Valentina get the weapons and start training to carry out their plan. Vanessa mourns her daughter’s death. They bury Diabla’s mother.

videos.title: Episode 72
videos.overview: Catalina, Nachito and Valentina threaten Daniela with death but Marcial and Capitán Pérez step in to avoid a tragedy.

videos.title: Episode 73
videos.overview: Catalina and Valentina consider paying someone to kill Daniela, although this would mean spending all the money Catalina's sister left her family.

videos.title: Episode 74
videos.overview: Nachito and Catalina dream about a future together. Aníbal accuses Nachito of a robbery. An ironic cackle turns into a clue.

videos.title: Episode 75
videos.overview: Diabla reappears before Aníbal’s eyes and threatens him. Nachito gives the Maríns valuable documents.

videos.title: Episode 76
videos.overview: Martina fools herself about Titi, who boasts he is the best narco, but his heart belongs to another woman. Nachito goes to the ranch with Catalina.

videos.title: Episode 77
videos.overview: Adriana’s burial is the perfect time to attack. Diabla orders her men to eliminate Catalina and Hilda. Aníbal negotiates murder terms.

videos.title: Episode 78
videos.overview: One of Aníbal’s bodyguards becomes a murderer. A massacre is about to erupt. Adriana’s final goodbye has a huge turnout. Marcial is depressed.

videos.title: Episode 79
videos.overview: The Maríns and their allies meet to make a decision. Catalina, Nachito and Valentina show their weapons and desire to fight but not everyone agrees.

videos.title: Episode 80
videos.overview: Diabla threatens to kill her doctor. Marcial might never walk again after his suicide attempt. Gato Gardo wants to take Martina’s life.

videos.title: Episode 81
videos.overview: Gato Gordo takes control and puts the plan into action. Diabla puts a hefty sum on the heads of the Maríns and Pipe’s mother.

videos.title: Episode 82
videos.overview: Catalina and Nachito swear their eternal love. Capitan Pérez suffers the consequences of selling his soul to Diabla. Catalina’s father loses his mind.

videos.title: Episode 83
videos.overview: Nachito convinces Albeiro that Catalina is the love of his life. Titi goes to the hospital to visit Marcial, who is in the depths of depression.

videos.title: Episode 84
videos.overview: The Maríns, Jota, Vanessa and Valentina unite forces to open up Diabla’s grave. Daniela is taken over by jealousy and decides it’s time for revenge.

videos.title: Episode 85
videos.overview: The Maríns and their allies take a DNA sample from one of Diabla’s victims and then make a key decision. Titi and Gato Gordo shake on a business deal.

videos.title: Episode 86
videos.overview: The plan is clear: it will have two phases. Aníbal is Diabla’s next victim. Martina is in love with a trafficker and her mother gives her some advice.

videos.title: Episode 87
videos.overview: Marcial gives the TEA agents the information they need to find and capture Diabla. This is the only way the first phase of the plan will work.

videos.title: Episode 88
videos.overview: Hilda and Albeiro give the TEA agents information about Diabla. Meanwhile, she sends her men to the ranch to finish off Catalina and her family.

videos.title: Episode 89
videos.overview: Hilda and Albeiro return to the ranch and Albeiro faces Diabla’s men. Catalina swears she won’t harm Diabla and Daniela in exchange for Nachito.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Everyone thinks Catalina la Grande is dead but she is alive and well. She made a deal with the TEA and now has a new life in the United States.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Catalina, now Virginia Fernández, starts her life in the U.S. Albeiro professes his eternal love to her before her “grave.”

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Martín offers Virginia employment as an undercover TEA agent. Soraya tries to seduce Santiago with deceit.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Virginia returns to Colombia to bury her past and give Jota instructions. Yésica goes to Mexico to make a deal. Virginia is given a promotion.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: 20 years go by. Yésica is a powerful drug trafficker. When she finds out that la Diabla isn’t dead, Virginia goes to Colombia to confront her enemy.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Virginia exposes la Diabla with a DNA test and escorts her to a prison in the U.S. The Maríns spend their first night in la Diabla’s mansion.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Virginia is rewarded for capturing la Diabla but first, she, Marcial, Hilda, and Albeiro will all have to testify.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: El Titi suggests that he, Daniela, and Gato Gordo all work together as partners. Daniela agrees to run la Diabla’s routes if el Titi kills Catalina.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Martín wants Catalina to go to Colombia undercover and trap el Titi. Daniela and Aníbal offer to team up with el Titi and Gato Gordo.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Hilda and Albeiro have to testify against la Diabla. Yésica plans her escape from prison. Virginia informs her children that they will go to Colombia.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Virginia offers Yésica a reduced penalty if she pleads guilty but she has two key witnesses who could bring her down.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Yésica records the conversation she has with the prison director. Daniela accuses Hernán Darío of stealing money from the safe.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Catalina la Pequeña submits to Daniela. Martín tells Virginia to seduce el Titi and trap him. La Diabla teams up with Mayra.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Santiago asks Virginia to quit the TEA so that they both can spend more time with their children. Yésica blackmails the director and plans to escape.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Catalina la Pequeña and Hernán Darío make love. Yésica meets her new lawyer. The prison director is forced to consent to la Diabla’s conditions.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Yésica hasn't made a decision about Virginia's proposal. La Diabla threatens her. Marcial gets a feeling that Titi is going to kill him.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Hilda and Albeiro find Catalina la Grande's grave empty. Yésica finds out the details for her escape and Titi tries to kill Marcial.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Hilda and Albeiro are excited to get to Miami. Virginia is tormented after seeing her mother and her first love but Albeiro finds her.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: La Diabla's escape plan takes shape in jail. Virginia is flustered after seeing her mother and Albeiro. Hilda demands to know what Albeiro is hiding.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Martín sets up a meeting between Virginia and Albeiro in an office at the courthouse. They intercept the van transporting la Diabla and three inmates.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Albeiro tells Hilda that he was with Catalina la Grande and that she never died but Hilda doesn't believe him.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Albeiro and Santiago meet. Chuky takes photos of Daniela and her step-father kissing and taking each other's clothes off. La Diabla worries everyone.

videos.title: Episodio  23
videos.overview: Albeiro tells Catalina la Pequeña her mother is in a coma after making sure that she is alive. La Diabla makes it to Mexico for a meeting with Chalo.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Santiago tells Catalina la Grande and Albeiro that Hilda will recover but when she wakes up, she'll have amnesia and have to start all over again.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Hilda doesn't recognize Albeiro and attacks him with scissors. Yésica visits her sister in Venezuela. Titi orders his men to scare Catalina.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Hilda is released and everyone travels to Colombia. Titi's men go to the hospital to kill Catalina la Pequeña. Yésica steals her sister's passport.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Mariana hides some marijuana in Albeiro's belongings. Titi's hitmen kill a patient by accident and Catalina la Pequeña is still alive.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Marcial finds out that Titi was behind the hospital attack. Catalina and her family make it to Colombia. La Diabla becomes Amparo to cross the border.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: While Albeiro and Hernán Darío take Hilda to the hospital, Titi's hitmen take advantage of the opportunity to attack the house.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Marcial and Catalina la Grande are reunited after 20 years and he apologizes to her. Catalina la Pequeña feels guilty for murdering two men.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Marcial tells Titi that he's ready to die. Catalina la Grande and Santiago invite Albeiro and Hernán Darío to spend the night at their house.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: La Diabla makes it to Pereira. Everyone realizes that Marcial has died and that Titi is behind it. Catalina la Grande remembers her time with Marcial.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Las Diablas reach the new ranch and plan to build an emergency tunnel. Hilda recovers part of her memory but she is referred to a psychiatrist.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Chuky burns the money that Daniela hid. The Captain is going to frame Chuky for Marcial's death. La Diabla stays on the street.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: The police arrest Albeiro and Jota for burning down Las Diablas' house. Yésica is furious when Daniela admits that she slept with Titi.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Mariana gets naked in front of Hernán Darío. Catalina la Grande sees them together and Mariana cuts her veins. Hilda is taken to the psychiatric ward.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Martín tells Virginia how to get to Titi and Gato Gordo: by moving to their old neighborhood. The agent traps Martina and wants her to be a TEA spy.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Hilda digs up the past and throws it in Virginia's face in front of Santiago. Mayra and Flavia join Las Diablas to set up a new cartel in Mexico City.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Gato Gordo and Titi film their meeting with their partners. Daniela suggests that Titi kill Gato Gordo. Nacho is disappointed by Catalina la Pequeña.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Calvo and his men attack Gato Gordo's ranch but he manages to escape with Titi. Las Diablas and Flavia prepare Mayra to become the cocaine queen.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Albeiro and Jota get out of jail. Gato Gordo wants to make a claim about the attack on his ranch. Chuky organizes a vigil for Marcial.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Titi suspects that Daniela gave the order to kill him so he confronts her but she denies it. Yésica changes her plan: she'll have to do it herself.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Virginia starts acting as an undercover agent in front of Paola and Martina. Gato Gordo gets shot in a fight.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: Titi is excited to hear Catalina la Grande's voice and wants to see her. She shows up in the neighborhood and sees her old friends.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: Catalina la Pequeña hears her sister yelling at her daughter and finds out what happened with Hernán Darío. Titi dreams of being number one.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: A heartbroken Catalina la Pequeña confronts Hernán Darío about his betrayal. La Diabla and Chalo plan to eliminate Gato Gordo and Titi in Mexico.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: Virginia plays the role of Catalina Santana on her date with Titi. He is thrilled and invites her to Mexico. Martin organizes an operation.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: Virginia and Titi get to Chalo's ranch in Mexico but the TEA is on their tail. Las Diablas' hitmen kidnap Hilda at Marcial's burial.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: Titi shoots Chalo and gunfire commences. Catalina la Grande joins in and Titi is surprised that she can use a gun. The TEA shows up at the ranch

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: Virginia pretends to be sick and Titi goes out to get her medicine. She uses the opportunity to give Martín their location.

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: Titi manages to flee the TEA. Virginia asks Martín to arrest her so that Titi isn't suspicious and he agrees so that she won't go back to Colombia.

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: Martín secretly takes Virginia to a rented house. Aníbal get to Daniela's "aunt's" house. She seduces him and Yésica shows up to torture him.

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: Virginia thinks that Martín is helping her but he has different intentions. Mariana manipulates Catalina la Pequeña.

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: Martín holds Virginia against her will and declares his love for her. La Diabla gets revenge and Titi looks for Chalo's competition.

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: La Diabla demands that Calvo seduce Hilda. Gato Gordo is at death's door but he has two last requests: one has to do with a crime.

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: Catalina tries to trick Martín so that she can escape. The policeman is clever and she swears her revenge. Santiago finds Martín.

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: Albeiro goes to Yésica's ranch to negotiate Hilda's freedom. Mayra pretends to be a narco by following La Diabla's instructions.

videos.title: Episode 58
videos.overview: Albeiro insists on negotiating Hilda's freedom. Mariana goes to a drunk Nacho's house. She pretends to be Catalina la Pequeña to confuse him.

videos.title: Episode 59
videos.overview: Mariana plays with Catalina la Pequeña's excitement. Catalina la Grande finds out that Hilda has been kidnapped. The past surprises Santiago.

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: Albeiro sends a drone to find Hilda. Daniela and La Diabla go to Aníbal's funeral. Yésica speaks to the governor. Titi calls Martina about business.

videos.title: Episode 61
videos.overview: Hilda hides from Calvo and La Diabla realizes that they're not there. Daniela glimpses a drone and warns her mother that she might be recognized.

videos.title: Episode 62
videos.overview: Catalina la Grande tries to find Santiago and his kids but he makes an irreversible decision and leaves a letter. Nachito wants to rescue his love.

videos.title: Episode 63
videos.overview: Martina tries to kill Titi for all the humiliation he caused her. Catalina la Pequeña is suspicious of Mariana and talks to Hernán Darío.

videos.title: Episode 64
videos.overview: Catalina la Grande and co. get ready to confront Las Diablas. Mariana and Sebastián leave because of their parents. Nacho tries to clear his name.

videos.title: Episode 65
videos.overview: Catalina la Grande shows up heavily armed at Las Diablas' ranch and sparks a massacre. Hilda refuses to go with her family and everyone is shocked.

videos.title: Episode 66
videos.overview: La Diabla takes Hilda to her new hiding place. A furious Catalina la Pequeña strangles Daniela. Catalina la Grande can't find her children.

videos.title: Episode 67
videos.overview: Daniela escapes. Catalina la Grande is alone and suffering after her children and husband abandon her. Hilda considers teaming up with Yésica.

videos.title: Episode 68
videos.overview: Albeiro and Yésica set up a meeting to exchange hostages. Catalina la Grande meets the new TEA boss. The new neighborhood pimp, Dayana, meets Titi.

videos.title: Episode 69
videos.overview: Yésica coordinates the meeting with Albeiro for the exchange. The neighborhood pimp goes after Mariana and is surprised to see Catalina.

videos.title: Episode 70
videos.overview: Catalina la Grande and her boss set up a secure area for the exchange. Dayana is ready to start recruiting her next victim: Mariana.

videos.title: Episode 71
videos.overview: Gunfire starts at the exchange and Albeiro and Jota are trapped. Dayana gives Mariana a hallucinogenic and she takes it, unaware of the consequences.

videos.title: Episode 72
videos.overview: Mariana is out of her mind due to the drugs and alcohol. She hallucinates that Titi is Hernán Darío and asks him to impregnate her.

videos.title: Episode 73
videos.overview: Mariana is repulsed after unabashedly sleeping with Titi. Yésica coerces Albeiro into her bed and takes photos to show Hilda.

videos.title: Episode 74
videos.overview: Catalina la Grande tells Mariana that she can get marijuana under three conditions. Hilda sends Albeiro a video message.

videos.title: Episode 75
